Name: CJB Cheats Menu
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: A simple in-game cheats menu with lots of cheats.
Description:
**CJB Cheats Menu** lets you press `P` (configurable) to open a full cheats menu:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/master/CJBCheatsMenu/docs/screenshot.gif)

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods#translating-the-mods)).**

## Install
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

## How to use
Load your save, then **press `P` on your keyboard** to show the cheats menu.

To change the button:
* On Linux/macOS/Windows, open the menu and then use the "Controls" tab to choose a different controller/keyboard/mouse button. (You can also [change `config.json` directly](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings) if needed.)
* On Android, see [_use key bindings on Android_](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Use_key_bindings_on_Android).

## Troubleshooting
1. **See "how to use" above.**
2. This mod isn't part of SMAPI. After installing SMAPI, see the install steps above.
3. The menu won't open if a different menu or dialogue is already open.
4. If it still doesn't work, ask in the comments!

## Compatibility
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer (even if other players don't have it installed).

In multiplayer, most cheats will only affect you. Other players won't see that you're using cheats (except indirectly, like seeing you zoom across the screen). The cheats affect all players:
* instant buildings;
* fast machine processing;
* harvest with sickle;
* money (if money is shared);
* durable fences;
* auto-feed;
* infinite hay;
* setting tomorrow's weather;
* time (only the main player can change time).
